description: AirWorker 0.11.11-rc.5: ChatGPT coordinator plus exactly two independent Codex code-writing workers in separate Git worktrees; no third Codex leader; GPT-6.1 ladder and independent Anthropic judge.

interface.shortDescription: Run native Codex orchestration and independent Claude review through AirWorker.
interface.longDescription: AirWorker is the sole native executor, judge and learning runtime for Codex, Claude and Hermes adapters. Use native session, PLAN, orchestrate and semantic receipts; the separate signed llm-queue worker is an optional heavy-task capability.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use the installed AirWorker kernel and woody skill, never direct Codex/Claude provider tools. After native session declare and PLAN readback, run the approved coding route with exactly TWO native Codex code-writing workers: air-worker orchestrate code -product <root> -task-file <TASK> -principal gpt -session-key <this-chat>, or the canonical Hermes air_worker(action=run). The native kernel selects Codex from script, GPT-6 Luna, GPT-6.1 Terra, GPT-6 Sol, GPT-6.1 Sol, GPT-6 Astra; escalate on proved cause only, never march all tiers blindly. Exactly two Codex coding workers independently EDIT files in separate Git worktrees, each with workspace-write and native terminal receipts; the current ChatGPT conversation is the coordinator and explicitly reviews/merges both genuine Git diffs, then runs factual QA and independent Anthropic review. There is NO third Codex leader and no automatic integration. Text-only patches do NOT count as working coding subagents. Require real source changes, factual Go RC, immutable receipts and an independent native Anthropic Sonnet/Opus judge before acceptance. Standalone executor dispatch is forbidden for this managed two-subagent product, and the previous two sequential dispatch pilots are historical only. Keep G07/G06/G05/G08 and release/install gates distinct. Never use Codex App Server, direct claude -p, PAYG or a custom router.
